# Copilot instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before acting. It is authoritative for task scope, required skill routing and the draft/review/CI lifecycle. Read [WebSite project guidance](../docs/AGENT_PROJECT_GUIDANCE.md) and [CSS governance](../docs/CSS_GOVERNANCE.md) when applicable.

The shared skills are checked in under `.agents/skills`. Follow their named procedures even if automatic skill selection does not load them. Open every PR as draft, record actual author/validation provenance and obtain independent current-source review before standard CI. Provider-managed or undisclosed model/effort must be recorded honestly and cannot satisfy an unverifiable strict model requirement.
